target.statement: Marginal distribution alignment error (average KS/TV distance) for TABKDE on the Adult dataset = 1.56

compute.basis: Paper reports TABKDE trains in ~44s and samples in ~20s on a laptop CPU for Adult; the method is pure numpy/scipy (copula + KDE), so a clean re-run plus install and data download should take well under an hour.

title: TabKDE: Simple and Scalable Tabular Data Generation with Kernel Density Estimates
